snippet.title: Next of Kin: Fidelity - Release Date Trailer + Demo Announcement
snippet.description:
This is the official release date trailer for our second game: “Next of Kin: Fidelity”, a 2D story-driven adventure.

"Next of Kin: Fidelity" releases on Steam, Xbox Series X/S, and Nintendo Switch on October 10th, 2025.

Download the demo now and wishlist on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3548270/Next_of_Kin_Fidelity/

Developed by Spelkväll Games (Robin and Jakob).
Music composed by Oliver Cox, Elijah Green, Felix Carlsten, and Mattias Forslund.

We bought assets to use in this game. Please check out these amazing asset creators and their work below:
